acceptanceCriteria: queue status, attempt show, ticket show and plan preview accept a compact selector and return only the requested fields or a one-line-per-item summary; measured bytes on a large fixture are recorded.
queue status omits the retries map unless asked, with the wire contract updated in the same change.
--help is terse by default; reason codes and preconditions remain available behind an explicit verbose flag.
docs/TASKS-EXTERNAL-AGENTS.md tells agents to request summaries instead of printing full JSON.
Maintained tests cover each selector, refusal of unknown fields, and byte bounds.
body:
Filed 2026-10-07 by the orchestrator session from GitHub issue beamfall/corvint#650 (owner: get it fixed and merged).

Observed on a 370-ticket queue: queue status 63 KB (retries map 64 KB of JSON), plan preview 120 KB, release --help 5 KB, attempt show 5 KB, ticket show 4.5 KB. 24 h of agent sessions returned 9.5 MB from 2,324 calls. Every byte stays in the agent context and is resent each turn.

Ask: a compact mode (--fields or --summary) on those reads; queue status without the retries map by default; terse --help by default with long reason codes behind --verbose; agent guidance in TASKS-EXTERNAL-AGENTS.

Evidence: docs/build-log/2026-10-07-v1-0935-compact-agent-output.md, docs/decisions/0441-rc3-gh650-653-requirements-accepted-2026-10-07.md and the 4 sealed staged CEMs .corvint/changes/ca228a4b808e2582be6537515518ed8f2e93889d.cem.json, .corvint/changes/ca97023c1a19ce91475fc4319282d9d8b3e7f753.cem.json, .corvint/changes/e7a18bdbfe47d7f72351ddda4ed194a0936d65fc.cem.json, .corvint/changes/f587d6bf08f4ff2c46c8d1e1bb111169a1af7ce6.cem.json at that commit (each digest is that file's sha256). The build-log entry records the change, the maintained tests and the Codex review with its repairs; decision 0441 records the owner's acceptance of CAL-V0-165..174. The batch passed focused package tests, the doc gates, dogfood check and seal per stage, and every hosted CI check on the final head e4b50dcb (after re-freezing the source_handoff.go native digest). NOT_RUN: make gate, live dispatcher/fleet/host qualification, older-binary run against share bindings. Native complete is refused with STALE_TREE (V1-0557), hence manual completion.
